props.title: Our Story
props.content:
Founded in 2025, we set out to revolutionize how businesses manage their web content. Our decoupled CMS approach gives you the best of both worlds: powerful content management with complete website independence.

We believe that your website should always be online, regardless of what happens to external services. That's why we built a system that syncs content locally while still providing the convenience of a centralized CMS.
